content: Hypothesis is the standard Python property-based testing library, integrates with pytest via strategies + shrinking. No off-the-shelf interval/scheduling strategy exists, but Hypothesis's composite strategies are well suited to generating random (start,end,tz) interval sets and asserting invariants (no double-booking, no negative-duration slots, grid alignment, DST-boundary correctness) -- a natural fit for verifying this engine's interval math and hold-atomicity logic exhaustively rather than only via fixed examples.
